title: Optimisation and mechanistic characterization of a selective benzoxazine-based MAP4K4 inhibitor in pancreatic cancer cells.
authors: Wu, Yi-Wen; Yang, Chun-Lin; Fang-Chin, Yu-Ting; Yeh, Yun-Hsuan; Chen, Bor-Jiun; Sung, Tzu-Ying; Chu, Jung-Chun; Lin, Tony Eight; Yen, Shih-Chung; Hsieh, Jui-Hua; Huang, Sing-Han; Chu, Cheng-Ying; Yang, Kai-Chien; Hsu, Kai-Cheng; Pan, Shiow-Lin
journal: Journal of enzyme inhibition and medicinal chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究胰腺癌中MAP4K4激酶抑制剂优化与机制表征，与CRISPR/碱基编辑/交错切割完全无关，无可迁移的分子机制启发。
abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains a lethal malignancy with limited targeted therapeutic options. Mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase kinase 4 (MAP4K4) has been implicated in PDAC progression, but the development of effective MAP4K4 inhibitors requires further improvement in potency, selectivity, and mechanistic characterisation. We previously identified F389-0746 as a selective benzoxazine-based MAP4K4 inhibitor with anti-cancer activity in pancreatic cancer. Here, we used the F389-0746 scaffold to guide the selection and evaluation of benzoxazine-based analogs, followed by biochemical, structural, selectivity, and cellular characterisation of the most potent analogue. Among the identified analogs, F389-0736 showed the strongest MAP4K4 inhibitory activity, with an IC(50) value of 44.0 nM, representing an approximately threefold improvement over F389-0746. Docking and structure-activity relationship analyses identified key binding interactions that support the enhanced potency of F389-0736 within the MAP4K4 binding pocket. Kinase profiling further demonstrated the selectivity of F389-0736 for MAP4K4 across the tested kinase panel. CETSA further demonstrated F389-0736-induced thermal stabilisation of MAP4K4, supporting intracellular target engagement. In pancreatic cancer cells, F389-0736 suppressed TAK1, JNK, and p38 phosphorylation and significantly reduced cell viability and proliferation, with IC(50) and GI(50) values of 4.41-4.65 muM and 4.03-5.12 muM, respectively. F389-0736 also inhibited clonogenic growth and induced sub-G1 accumulation with activation of apoptotic signalling. RNA sequencing identified 398 differentially expressed genes and revealed enrichment of inflammatory and stress response pathways, programmed cell death programs, oncogenic signalling perturbation, and metabolic reprogramming. These findings identify F389-0736 as a potent and selective benzoxazine-based MAP4K4 inhibitor and support its use as a chemical probe and lead scaffold for investigating MAP4K4-dependent signalling and therapeutic vulnerability in pancreatic cancer.
abstract_zh: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）仍是一种致死性恶性肿瘤，靶向治疗选择有限。丝裂原活化蛋白激酶激酶激酶激酶4（MAP4K4）已被涉及在PDAC进展中，但开发有效的MAP4K4抑制剂仍需在效力、选择性和机制表征方面进一步改进。我们先前鉴定出F389-0746作为一种选择性苯并噁嗪类MAP4K4抑制剂，在胰腺癌中具有抗癌活性。在此，我们利用F389-0746骨架指导苯并噁嗪类类似物的筛选和评估，随后对最有效类似物进行生化、结构、选择性和细胞表征。在鉴定出的类似物中，F389-0736显示出最强的MAP4K4抑制活性，IC(50)值为44.0 nM，较F389-0746约提高三倍。对接和构效关系分析确定了支持F389-0736在MAP4K4结合口袋中增强效力的关键结合相互作用。激酶谱分析进一步证明了F389-0736在测试激酶面板中对MAP4K4的选择性。CETSA进一步证明F389-0736诱导MAP4K4的热稳定性，支持细胞内靶点结合。在胰腺癌细胞中，F389-0736抑制TAK1、JNK和p38磷酸化，并显著降低细胞活力和增殖，IC(50)和GI(50)值分别为4.41-4.65 μM和4.03-5.12 μM。F389-0736还抑制克隆形成生长，并诱导亚G1期积累及凋亡信号激活。RNA测序鉴定出398个差异表达基因，并揭示炎症和应激反应通路、程序性细胞死亡程序、致癌信号扰动和代谢重编程的富集。这些发现将F389-0736鉴定为一种强效且选择性的苯并噁嗪类MAP4K4抑制剂，并支持其作为化学探针和先导骨架用于研究胰腺癌中MAP4K4依赖性信号传导和治疗脆弱性。
